src/app/__tests__/continue.test.tsx:138 — only the 64 sp branch of cardType is asserted for the continue lines; no narrow-width case and no assertion of the new accessibilityLabel → add one narrow-window test and an accessibilityLabel assertion

scripts/test-acceptance.sh:398-420 — NFR-07 colour check on the continue screen is unconfirmed on CI. The rule rows sit at different y on this screen, so the earlier CI pass of the first-launch check does not guarantee this one passes. Non-blocking because the failure is environmental and not caused by the diff → wait for the pending acceptance job on this head; if it fails on rows 1251/1257-type rule rows, fix or relax the check (do not rename it away)
